purpose: Test whether reassigning already learned temporal embeddings changes segmentation on frozen spread-window memory reads, without changing memory values, selected keys, initial prompt, current query, pointers or subsequent propagation.
scope: Sequence 3 engineering reads 8 and 12; previously inspected inset-excluded sequence 23 reads 8,20,35,48,51. The sequence and frames were selected after the spread-window and memory-swap results. All outputs are exploratory.
capture: Reuse existing read-only author attention/decoder snapshot observer during a reproduced spread run. Check every mask and saved trajectory trace against the frozen original; verify two engineering captures independently before sequence 23 capture. Never feed labels to inference or add later detector search, confidence gate or threshold.
interventions: Keep original memory values, conditioning positions, insurance positions, object pointers, current query, decoder prompt inputs and all key counts fixed. Verify each retained frame block against its archived selected tokens, actual original spatial grid and true clamped temporal embedding. Decode its retained original spatial indices. No-op uses actual clamped positions. Rank control assigns the existing six learned nonconditioning slots in chronological order, newest keeps the newest slot; older slots are relative rank, not real age. Permuted control reverses the older-frame slot order while keeping newest unchanged and uses the same slot multiset as rank. Rebuild position vectors from the same spatial grid and the chosen existing checkpoint embeddings; never introduce new or untrained parameters. Indexed spatial RoPE still uses each original grid coordinate. No output is fed back into later reads.
verification: Unit-test exact block boundaries, offset substitution, key/pointer preservation, spatial indices and matched rank/permuted slot multisets. Require no-op attention and decoder outputs and saved masks to match exactly, source IDs and token lengths to match the recorded admission, each original block position to match reconstructed grid+original slot, and parameter integrity. Repeat seq3 diagnostic in two fresh processes, then repeat seq23 diagnostic in two fresh processes. Freeze all masks before labels and independently rescore selected-frame Dice, false alarms and changed pixels.
limits: Relative rank is not the actual source-frame age and is not a trained replacement. Comparisons isolate a local change in positional inputs only, not causal effects of real age diversity, a deployable policy, propagated video quality or patient generalization. Decoding effects depend on other saved memory and pointer contents. Frames and controls are post-hoc.
